description:
Role Title: Senior FreeCAD Engineer
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
We are engaging Senior FreeCAD Engineers to contribute expertise to a dynamic customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Required Skills

• Parametric CAD Modeling

• Python Scripting

• Mechanical Engineering

• GD&T

• CAD Automation

• Assembly Design

• Technical Drawings

• Create, modify, and validate detailed parametric CAD models in FreeCAD to specified project requirements.

• 2+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, product design, or industrial engineering or any other related field with a focus on parametric CAD modeling.

• Advanced proficiency in FreeCAD or equivalent parametric CAD platforms.

• Strong knowledge of mechanical design fundamentals, including GD&T and DFM best practices.

• Demonstrated ability to produce comprehensive technical drawings and documentation for manufacturing and assembly.

• Experience conducting engineering QA and verifying model integrity and compliance with specifications.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills relevant to remote, project-based collaboration.

title: SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
description:
SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.
The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.
Responsibilities:

• Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.

• Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.

• Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.

• Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.

• Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.

• Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.

• Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.

• Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

• 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.

• Understanding of banking data environment.

• Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.

• Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.

• Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.

• In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.

• Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.

• Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
description:
Role Title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Quantitative Rates Researchers to contribute to a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Review and assess AI-generated quantitative research and trading strategy outputs focused on fixed income and rates markets

• Identify and document methodological issues such as lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions

• Evaluate the accuracy of backtesting frameworks, especially with respect to rates-specific mechanics like carry/roll-down and contract roll conventions

• Scrutinize the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research in the provided outputs

• Deliver detailed written feedback on model assumptions, implementation fidelity, and research soundness

• Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators by clarifying findings and suggestions through clear written and verbal communication

• Contribute to the refinement of research evaluation processes for greater accuracy and relevance

Preferred Qualifications

• Background as a quantitative researcher, analyst, or consultant with expertise in fixed income or rates markets

• Demonstrated experience building and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset manager, or bank

• Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scipy) or R for quantitative research and data analysis

• Strong understanding of yield curve modeling, carry/roll-down analytics, relative value trading, SOFR/Eurodollar instruments, and Treasury futures

• Comfort evaluating research under real-world trading conditions, including transaction costs and liquidity constraints

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to articulate complex quantitative findings in clear, concise written feedback

• Prior experience assessing or reviewing models for compliance with best practices in quantitative finance is a plus

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
About the Role
Abnormal AI is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to ensure Abnormal’s FedRAMP environment operates securely, resiliently, and efficiently. This role focuses on security operations engineering, with responsibilities spanning CI/CD pipelines, access management, patch management, change reviews, incident response, and security automation. The engineer will directly own and improve the technical workflows that keep Abnormal Gov systems compliant and resilient at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep cloud and infrastructure security expertise with operational discipline, and is AI-enabled to maximize efficiency and reduce overhead.
What you will do

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines to support secure deployments and infrastructure workflows.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code (IaC) PR and Change Control Board reviews, ensuring changes are tested, approved, and secure before release.

• Perform security impact analyses (SIAs) for system/application changes and provide recommendations.

• Run OS and infrastructure patch cycles; manage hardened images and patch workflows for FedRAMP environments.

• Govern access management, including account provisioning, RBAC module maintenance, and periodic reviews.

• Manage logging and monitoring pipelines; tune SIEM ingestion and alerting for coverage and accuracy.

• Triage and respond to security incidents, from alert investigation through containment, recovery, and after-action reporting.

• Maintain and refine runbooks, SOPs, and documentation to ensure consistent operations and audit readiness.

• Collaborate with DevInfra, FedOps, Product, and Compliance teams to embed secure practices into operations and development.

Must Haves

• 5 - 7 years in security engineering or infrastructure operations within federal or regulated cloud environments.

• Strong familiarity with NIST 800-53 controls and continuous monitoring practices.

• Proven delivery of AWS/SaaS security best practices.

• Hands-on expertise with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and IaC security practices.

• Experience in patch management, hardened baselines, and secure image pipelines.

• Strong knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) design and enforcement in large-scale environments.

• Proven ability to manage SIEM pipelines and lead Tier 1/ Tier 2 incident response.

• Strong technical documentation, collaboration, and incident/project management skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience integrating security automation into CI/CD pipelines and SecOps workflows.

• Prior experience supporting federal audits or 3PAO engagements.

• Knowledge of SaaS security operations and monitoring at scale.

• Experience driving automation in security operations, compliance tracking, and evidence management.

• Knowledge of SaaS security operations and modern cloud environments; exposure to DevSecOps pipelines or security reviews for Terraform/containers.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

$153,000-$220,000 USD

This Week in Fintech https://thisweekinfintech.com/ is the largest global fintech media company with 200,000+ subscribers to a publication that provides insights, news, and connections within the financial technology ecosystem. What began as a newsletter focused on curating and sharing industry updates, trends, and innovations in the fintech space has grown to include a range of products including podcasts, events, conferences, and an online community to bring together fintech professionals, investors, and enthusiasts worldwide.

This Week in Fintech is looking for an Account Executive with experience in advertising and media sales and is eager to build and grow their own book of business by selling across our diverse media offerings (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, events, and sponsored content).

In this role you’ll be a frontline ambassador for the brand, including; opening doors, pitching creative solutions, and building long-term partnerships with some of the most influential names in fintech, crypto, finance, venture capital, and beyond.

As Senior Channel Manager, you will own CIQ ’s channel-led revenue as an individual contributor, reporting directly to the company’s sales leadership. title: Head of Product
description:
About Hashgraph:

Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera is EVM-compatible and has been specifically built to meet the needs of enterprise and web3 applications, which require speed, security, stability and sustainability. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralized platform.

Why this role exists:

Assets are landing on ledgers faster than anyone has built a way to move them between ledgers. Collateral sits on one chain while the position it should be margining sits on another. Delivery-versus-payment and payment-versus-payment both work inside a single ledger and both break the moment the two legs live in different places. The available workarounds are bridges, which have lost more than $2.8 billion since 2021.

The team that built Hedera from the ground up is now building a cross-ledger solution for institutional settlement: collateral mobility, DvP, PvP, cross-border payments, and FX across public and private ledgers that do not otherwise interoperate.

Your job will be to define the product and own the roadmap. You will report to the founder.

In this role, you will:

- Own the product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and roadmap.

- Work closely with business development on go-to-market execution for the product. Define the product the market needs and business development can sell..

- Report product status and roadmap changes directly to the founders and executive team.

- Design and run trials with external validators, partners, and customers.

- Make the release readiness call on performance, security, and usability. Ask the tough questions before launch, not after.

- Run program management across every stakeholder group. Keep BD, Marketing, and Engineering in sync.

What success looks like in 12 months:

- Live settlement for the priority use cases of cross-border payments, settlements, treasury management, and tokenized deposits, with named institutional counterparties moving real value.

- You will have built working on/off-ramps supporting the use cases above.

- BD, marketing, and engineering each independently say you are the reason they are shipping faster.

What you bring:

Core capabilities:

- 10+ years in product management, product leadership, or an equivalent operating role.

- 5+ years of that inside FX, payments, settlement, clearing, custody, collateral management, or banking infrastructure.

- Real operating experience in FX exchange, payments, settlement, or banking-rail businesses. You understand cross-border payments, stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and how players like SWIFT and Stripe fit together.

- Direct working knowledge of at least two of: FX execution and settlement, cross-border payments, DvP or PvP settlement, collateral mobility, treasury operations, tokenized deposits.

Functional expertise:

- Experience owning a roadmap end to end, including making the right, hard calls.

- Experience writing product requirements that an engineering team built from directly.

- Experience presenting to executives, boards, or institutional steering committees.

Preferred skills and experience:

- Distributed ledger or Layer 1 experience.

- Work inside a consortium, governing council, or member-owned network model.

- Exposure to CCIP, Circle and ARC, Canton, Ripple, or comparable enterprise platforms.

- Stablecoin mechanics, on-ramps and off-ramps, tokenized collateral.

- First product hire or zero-to-one experience at an early-stage company.

Candidates who meet the basic qualifications and none of the preferred should still apply. The preferred list is learnable in a quarter.

Travel to customer, validator, and partner sites, including international travel will be required.

title: Gas Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

Role Scope

- Negotiate behind-the-meter PPAs, tolling agreements, and heat rate options with generation owners and developers for multi-hundred-megawatt data center campuses.

- Negotiate gas supply, transport, and basis arrangements that lock in fuel price and deliverability for each behind-the-meter site before the build starts.

- Diligence prospective behind-the-meter gas sites for pipeline access, fuel constraints, air permitting, and power delivery risk before we commit to a lease.

- Evaluate generation equipment (for example turbines and reciprocating engines) on heat rate, availability, lead time, emissions, and delivered cost, and turn it into a clear recommendation for leadership.

- Quarterback development, engineering, legal, and finance from site selection through executed supply contracts to energization, and flag cost and schedule exposure before it reaches leadership.

What We’re Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don’t fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You’ve personally negotiated behind-the-meter PPAs, tolls, or heat rate options where the economics had to hold through project finance and final deal terms.

- You’ve negotiated gas supply agreements and managed fixed-price, index, and basis exposure, and you know which fuel constraints break a plant’s dispatch.

- You’ve diligenced a gas-fired site from pipeline access and fuel deliverability through air permits and power delivery, and you know what kills a site early.

- You’ve compared generation technologies on heat rate, spark-spread economics, and reliability, and your analysis drove an equipment decision.

- You’ve built the techno-economic models behind these deals and defended the sensitivities to lenders, investors, or executives.

- You quarterback across engineering, legal, finance, and operations, and you write clearly enough to distill a technical question into a decision and a next step for a CEO.

- Bonus: Multi-market power experience (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, WECC). Plant dispatch and fuel optimization (generator, asset manager, or trading desk). Large-load and utility interconnection. Pipeline capacity and midstream contracting.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Fördermittelmanagement erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Projektförderung und Digitalisierung. Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team bei öffentlich geförderten Forschungsprojekten und arbeitest an Themen wie Reporting, Datenaufbereitung und Prozessoptimierung.

Bei uns kannst du Finance nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft kennenlernen, sondern auch aktiv mitgestalten: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, entwickeln neue Prozesse und nutzen moderne Technologien wie KI, um unsere Arbeit effizienter zu machen. output

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s Chemical Simulation group combines physics-based simulation, AI, materials science, and experimental validation to accelerate the discovery and commercialization of materials that matter to industry and national resilience.

We are seeking a Director, Strategic Partnerships & Alliances to build and execute the partnership strategy supporting our semiconductor-materials programs for our CHIPS funding and broader commercial ambitions. This role will identify high-value partners across the materials value chain, develop relationships with senior technical and business leaders, and turn promising scientific opportunities into structured government-funded relationships and commercial engagements.

• Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.

• Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.

• Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

About You

• 3-6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).

• Proven experience managing frontline teams and third-party vendors or operators.

• Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.

• Data-literate - comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

• Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.

• Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.

• Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .

• Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.

• Hone your stakeholder management skills by interacting with international stakeholders.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.
We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.
What We’re Looking For in a Cloud Native Consultant
We are looking for cloud native engineers and consultants at all levels to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.
This is a remote position, but we invite you to spend time in person at our London office: this is optional and we aim to be entirely flexible to your needs.
As part of the engineering team we may ask you to be involved in pre-sales or business development activities to support the ongoing growth of our organisation.
Role, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Cloud Native Consultant

• Experience and a deep understanding of Kubernetes using GKE, EKS or OpenShift

• Experience with one or more cloud providers and Infrastructure as Code tools and practices

• Experience with GitOps tooling such as FluxCD or ArgoCD

• Development experience with Golang, Python, or Java

• Understanding of CI/CD best practices and a range of build tools

• Cloud security awareness and a desire to build hardened systems

• Customer facing/Consulting experience.

What you'll bring (Desirable):

• Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE

• Experience with Hashicorp Vault/OpenBao

• Experience with Zero Trust Architectures, tools and practices

Benefits

• Generous and competitive salary + Bonus

• 33 days of paid holiday, including paid leave for the standard 8 UK Bank Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Private Medical and Dental Insurance

• An individual training budget for personal development, including but not limited to:

• Conferences

We are looking for technical practitioners who can work with our clients and the team to deliver these projects and help establish ControlPlane as a world-class technical thought leader.

title: CC How to Think Freelance Writer
description:
Freelance Writer

How do we make decisions? argue? persuade? research? evaluate? Basically, how do we think? This course will pull together insights across disciplines to explore all the ways we can think about thinking and apply it in our lives. If you’re an experienced writer, researcher, and thinker who can explain complex topics in clear and creative ways, we’d love to hear from you!

Crash Course, owned by Complexly , is an award-winning YouTube channel that invites students, teachers, and lifelong learners to tackle subjects they might have had trouble with or are curious to learn more about. Our videos take traditional classroom concepts and combine them with engaging and insightful narratives to help people learn and understand.

More details on the position:

Job Title: Writer

Status: Freelance

Reports to: Script Editor

Location: Remote, US-Based

Term: Beginning January 2027

Pay: $800 per script

What you'll do:

Write approximately 10 scripts, each ~1800-2000 words for our Crash Course How to Think series. These scripts will be based on episode outlines created by the Complexly editorial team, but writers are expected to provide additional research, insights, and ideas to create accurate and engaging scripts.

We’re looking for a deep thinker who can take an interdisciplinary approach, pulling from the sciences and humanities to help us guide viewers to reflect and deepen their understanding of how to ask questions, build knowledge, evaluate and share information, and make decisions. We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience “thinking about thinking.” Fields that come to mind include philosophy, education, psychology, or communication.

About Complexly :

Complexly is a media company that produces shows like Crash Course, SciShow, Eons, Ask Hank Anything, Bizarre Beasts, Study Hall, and more. We were founded by John and Hank Green with a mission of creating trustworthy stuff and lowering barriers to knowledge building. The world is not simple. And that can seem like a burden sometimes. The reality is, the human species will never fully understand itself or its universe, let alone any individual. But instead of seeing that as a failing, we'd like to suggest that the process is as powerful as the outcome.

Complexly was a company privately owned by Hank and John Green. As of 2026, they have donated the company to the public as a new nonprofit 501c3 organization, which will help Complexly fulfill its mission for decades to come. Becoming a nonprofit means we will be able to lean into public support, supercharging our mission to make content the world needs, not what is optimized for advertisers.

To learn more about Complexly , visit our website:

Complexly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in, and are dedicated to, the principles of equal opportunity in any term, condition or privilege of employment. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender including gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, military/veteran status, citizenship, arrest and court record, genetic information, credit history, or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.
